name: ai-indian-standards-engine
description: AI-Powered Indian Standards Recommendation Engine for Procurement Specifications

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const s = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'server', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const c = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'client', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"
